title: Score
description: Computed by the domain only, never entered nor stored (FR-016). `computed` is null unless `complete`. `rank` is the 1-based position among the complete features after the FR-014 sort, null when not complete.

complete.description: True when the method declares the feature computable (all criteria entered and within the current scale).

outOfScale.description: Criteria entered but outside the current scale (displayed "hors échelle", FR-011).

computed.description: By key of methodDefinition.computedValues; null when not complete.

explanation.description: Calculation detail with the real values (FR-016), written by the method; null when not complete.
